scope: Source-bound assessment of existing #30/#32 evidence; no new execution, pipeline promotion or baseline change

decisions.stdin_transport: Suitable for a separately tested reusable change; require ownership-scoped teardown on client timeout. Exact payload delivery and one live parity control are established, universal shell equivalence is not.
decisions.outer_completion_gate: Do not promote alone. Actual Bash experiments show outer exit/markers can hide failing inner runner exits.
decisions.pytest_completion: Promising opt-in candidate: retain setup/transport/marker checks and capture inner pytest exit; accept ordinary test failures, reject interruption/no-tests/usage failures. Evidence is synthetic real pytest plus standalone verifier, not full biological Harbor validation.
decisions.runner_coverage: Do not apply pytest-only validation as a universal replacement; it skips non-pytest commands including the OHIF/Jest cohort.
decisions.target_selection: Keep separate from completion correctness: choosing surviving/changed tests changes scope. It did not recover Matchms958 and remains unvalidated on MNE.
decisions.samtools: Recognition alone is insufficient: repeated headings and composite make targets require stable identities and completion coverage.

next_integration_boundary: Keep existing official baseline and #34 frozen comparison unchanged. A future consolidated candidate must independently test transport timeout cleanup, runner-specific completion, and ordinary exit1 behavior before broader rollout.
